stages: Read explicit library YAML and attach a clean pinned baseline.
Discover APIs; review bounded source/profile/development-error context.
Generate or select README and propose aliases, hints and refactor candidates.
Review changes, run library regression checks, and install exact treatment versions.
Supply independent held-out tasks/oracles and trusted condition-aware adapters.
Validate every backend control and freeze common protocol/input identities.
Generate fresh audience solutions with bounded repairs; retain all attempts.
Report matched microtask/puzzle scores, unresolved work and resources.
implemented: Bounded library-wide and small-scope proposal paths
Multi-file treatment bundles and separate versioned source refactors
Conservative duplicate candidates and comparable before/after reports
Five-arm, six-arm and original/refactor-pair control validation and evaluation
Recorded request/exposure, backend/evidence and resume checks
required_per_library: Independent task bank, oracle and negative controls
Reviewed treatment artifacts and explicit provider/runtime configuration
experimental_status: Toolkit and local validation capabilities; no completed hosted-model effectiveness result is included in this publication.
